These test-only utilities retain fixed official Codex release provenance and
source-equivalence checks. They do not select a production runtime. Public
metadata is frozen at its recorded observation; downloaded assets always require
the recorded published SHA256. No live metadata API token is needed.

The retired Linux ptrace experiment and its exact pre-revision files, modes and
patch are preserved outside Git in the workspace evidence archive
`l2-core-first-quarantine-v1`. It is not a shipping backend or an acceptance gate.
